senses.gloss:
अञ्ज् 7. 10. P. (अनज्मि, अञ्जयामि; अञ्ज् 10. a grammaticis
scribitur अज्)
1) ire, v. अञ्जस्.
2) splendere.
3) oblinere, ungere, praesertim cl. 10. MAN. 4.44.: {#aYjayantI
svake netre#} oblinens oculos suos (lat. ungo).
c. वि Caus.
1) manifestare, arguere. MAN. 10.38. Pass.
व्यज्यते (gr. 503. 538.). HIT. 103.20.
2) creare. MAN. 1.6.

अञ्जलि m. manuum junctio, implicatio (Wils. explicat:
The cavity formed by putting the hands together and hollowing
the palms, as if to receive water, etc.).

अञ्जस् n. (r. अञ्ज् s. अस्) celeritas. SA. 6.44. instr. अञ्जसा
Adv. celeriter.
